run.question:
You are an SRE agent tasked with diagnosing issues in a Kubernetes application.

Application: Hotel Reservation
Namespace: hotel-reservation

A hotel reservation application built with Go and gRPC, providing backend in-memory and persistent databases, a recommender system for hotel recommendations, and a functionality to place reservations.

CRITICAL: You are running in an AUTOMATED environment. Work autonomously and make all decisions yourself. DO NOT ask for user confirmation or approval. Proceed with the best solution based on your analysis.

TASK: DIAGNOSIS
- Investigate the application to detect any anomalies or issues
- Analyze metrics, logs, and traces
- When ready, submit a natural language description of the issue you found
- Your diagnosis is evaluated on whether you correctly identify the faulty components and root cause

Important:
- You can query metrics and traces through the available observability tools

report.summary: The hotel-reservation application is failing on its hotel-search path. A ResourceQuota named memory-limit-quota exists in namespace hotel-reservation with hard memory 1Gi and creationTimestamp 2026-11-21T14:57:28Z, but every pod template in the namespace, including the search container hotel-reserv-search, declares only CPU resources and no memory request or limit. After the existing search pod search-567bb6c4b8-kpxb8 was stopped at 14:57:28Z, its ReplicaSet search-567bb6c4b8 tried nine times to recreate a pod and every attempt was rejected with 'failed quota: memory-limit-quota: must specify memory for: hotel-reserv-search'; Deployment search now has no ready replica, the search Service has empty endpoints, and frontend HTTP GET /hotels fails with 500 whose child client span /search.Search/Nearby is in error. Other frontend paths (/recommendations, /reservation, /user) returned 200 in the sampled traces and the other pods are Running, ready, with zero restarts. Who created the quota and who stopped the search pod is unknown because change history is not an available data source in this Run.

claims.text: ResourceQuota hotel-reservation/memory-limit-quota exists with spec.hard.memory=1Gi, status.used.memory=0, and creationTimestamp 2026-11-21T14:57:28Z.

All 19 Deployments in namespace hotel-reservation (consul, frontend, geo, jaeger, memcached-profile, memcached-rate, memcached-reserve, mongodb-geo, mongodb-profile, mongodb-rate, mongodb-recommendation, mongodb-reservation, mongodb-user, profile, rate, recommendation, reservation, search, user) declare no memory request in their pod templates; the search container hotel-reserv-search declares only limits.cpu=1 and requests.cpu=100m.

Deployment search has 1 desired replica but no readyReplicas and no availableReplicas; its ReplicaSet search-567bb6c4b8 has status.replicas=0 and a ReplicaFailure condition (True) at 2026-11-21T14:57:30Z with message: pods "search-567bb6c4b8-c96qc" is forbidden: failed quota: memory-limit-quota: must specify memory for: hotel-reserv-search.

ReplicaSet search-567bb6c4b8 emitted 9 FailedCreate events between 2026-11-21T14:57:30Z and 14:57:31Z, each reading: Error creating: pods "search-567bb6c4b8-<suffix>" is forbidden: failed quota: memory-limit-quota: must specify memory for: hotel-reserv-search.

Pod search-567bb6c4b8-kpxb8 was scheduled at 14:57:16Z, its container hotel-reserv-search created and started at 14:57:17Z, and it was stopped at 14:57:28Z by a Killing event ('Stopping container hotel-reserv-search'); Deployment search then recorded 'Scaled up replica set search-567bb6c4b8 from 0 to 1' at 14:57:30Z, with deployment generation still 1 (template unchanged by the restart).

18 pods currently exist in hotel-reservation, all phase Running, all containers ready and with restartCount 0, created between 14:57:14Z and 14:57:18Z (before the 14:57:28Z quota); no pod belonging to Deployment search appears in that list.

Service search (ClusterIP, ports 8082 and 9092, selector io.kompose.service=search) has an empty subsets list, while the other services in the same endpoints read (consul, frontend, profile, rate, recommendation, reservation, user, geo and the remaining database services) each have populated addresses and ports.

In the sampled frontend traces for the window ending 2026-11-21T14:57:42Z, all 19 shown 'HTTP GET /hotels' spans carry error=true with http.status_code=500 and otel.status_code=ERROR, and all 19 shown frontend client spans '/search.Search/Nearby' carry error=true with otel.status_code=ERROR and a CHILD_OF parent reference to those /hotels spans; no search-service span appears and 'search' is not among Jaeger's listed services (frontend, profile, recommendation, reservation, user).

Other frontend paths succeeded in the same sampling window: 11 'HTTP GET /recommendations' spans with http.status_code=200 with matching profile and recommendation server spans; 5 'HTTP POST /reservation' spans with http.status_code=200 with matching reservation server spans '/reservation.Reservation/MakeReservation'; 5 'HTTP POST /user' spans with http.status_code=200 with matching user server spans '/user.User/CheckUser'.

The 500s on GET /hotels trace to search having no running pod: ResourceQuota memory-limit-quota rejects creation of every replacement search pod because container hotel-reserv-search has no memory request, so the search Service has no endpoints and frontend calls to /search.Search/Nearby fail immediately (span durations 21-76us). Because every deployment template in the namespace also lacks a memory request, the same block would apply to any hotel-reservation pod recreated while this quota is in effect.

Consul service discovery being down was considered as the cause of the failed search lookups, based on frontend's startup log at 14:57:15Z ('error retrieving instances from Consul: Get http://consul:8500/v1/health/service/srv-search?passing=1: dial tcp 10.96.207.210:8500: connect: connection refused'), but that line precedes consul becoming reachable: consul-5c767d7459-222vl is Running/ready with restartCount 0, the consul Service endpoints are populated (10.244.234.168:8500), and Consul-resolved calls to profile, recommendation, reservation and user all returned 200 in the sampled traces.

A namespace-wide outage is not supported: 18 of the 19 workloads' pods are Running and ready with restartCount 0, the search Service is the only one with an empty subsets list in the endpoints read, and frontend paths other than GET /hotels returned 200 in the sampled traces.

Human follow-up, not executed: give hotel-reserv-search a memory request and limit sized within the 1Gi memory-limit-quota (or remove/raise the quota) so the ReplicaSet can create the pod, and add memory requests/limits to the other hotel-reservation deployment templates so future pod recreation is not rejected the same way.

gaps: Change history is not an integrated data source in this Run (change_history is listed as not integrated), so who or what created ResourceQuota memory-limit-quota and who stopped pod search-567bb6c4b8-kpxb8 at 2026-11-21T14:57:28Z is unknown; only the coincidence in time of the two is observed.

No application-level Prometheus series were found: sum by (service_name,status_code)(increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total[1h])) at 2026-11-21T14:57:42Z returned no data, and kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready{namespace="hotel-reservation"} returned no samples for 14:47:42Z-14:57:42Z, so no metric-based error-rate or ready-replica reading backs the trace and API evidence.

The query traces_search_by_tags(service=frontend, operation="HTTP GET /hotels", tags=http.status_code="200", 14:50:00Z-14:57:42Z) returned no traces, so whether GET /hotels ever succeeded before the search pod was stopped is unknown; the observed 500 spans come only from the last second of the sample (span start times around 2026-11-21T14:57:41.5Z-14:57:41.9Z).

Log reads for geo-d4c78b89b-vtnc5 (container hotel-reserv-geo) and rate-65d6967c95-pxmdh (container hotel-reserv-rate) with an error/auth/failure regex over 14:55:00Z-14:57:42Z returned zero matching lines from a status=no_data view; that neither confirms nor refutes application errors in those services, and it is recorded only as an unchecked signal.

Frontend log output for 14:57:30Z-14:57:42Z returned no lines (the readable window ends at 2026-11-21T14:57:16.54Z), so there is no per-request application error log line for the 500s; the error evidence is the trace status tags only.

Trace and span counts come from a biased Jaeger sample (backend returned as many traces as requested, noted incomplete), so the 19 error spans are not an error rate, and search-side server spans cannot be inspected; the direct traces_search for services 'reservation' and 'user' was rejected with INVALID_PARAMS, so those services were only seen as child spans of frontend traces.
NetworkPolicies could not be examined: the query for kind networkpolicies in hotel-reservation returned no data, so a connectivity cause other than missing endpoints is unchecked.

All Kubernetes objects (quota, deployments, pods, endpoints, events) were read at query time after 2026-11-21T14:57:28Z; the cluster state before the 14:57:14Z object creation timestamps is unknown, and one event outside the authorized window was dropped by the tools.
next_steps: Inspect the audit or GitOps/CI change log that created ResourceQuota hotel-reservation/memory-limit-quota at 2026-11-21T14:57:28Z and that stopped pod search-567bb6c4b8-kpxb8 in the same second.

After approval, add memory requests/limits to the hotel-reserv-search container and the other hotel-reservation deployment templates, then confirm a search pod schedules and the search Service gains endpoints.
Re-check frontend HTTP GET /hotels status codes and the /search.Search/Nearby client span status after the fix to confirm the 500s stop.
